thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: Should I wait after waking before drinking coffee? Does coffee on an empty stomach hurt?
thread_summary: Look for someone asking about the best time for the first coffee, or acidity and jitters on an empty stomach.
text: The advice to wait 90 minutes after waking to avoid a cortisol clash is popular, but the evidence behind it is thin. What is better supported: if coffee on an empty stomach gives you acidity or jitters, have it with or after food, and keep the total reasonable. Many adults do fine up to around 400 mg a day, and with a half-life of about 5 hours the last cup should be early afternoon. Try it for a week each way and see what your own body says.
why: Honest myth-check on a common question. Reinforces that we are careful with evidence.
format: Comment bank (pick a post from the last 3 days)
rules: NON-NEGOTIABLE: reply only to a thread posted in the last 3 days (check the timestamp under the title). If nothing that recent fits, skip this comment and mark it Rejected with a note.
